rules: GitHub event type is not a runtime dependency signal.
CODE_VALID validates code/contracts and does not require current runtime receipts.
DEPLOYMENT_VALID requires fresh healthy evidence only for the deployment components explicitly named by the claim.
RUNTIME_HEALTHY requires fresh healthy evidence only for the runtime components explicitly named by the claim.
External-action and acceptance claims use RUNTIME_HEALTHY semantics for their named component dependencies.
Stale runtime evidence never blocks unrelated code/PR/push work.
Missing, malformed, mismatched, future-dated, evidence-less, non-healthy or stale receipts fail closed when their component is a real live dependency.
A live scope with no dependency list fails closed rather than silently checking every runtime.
Legacy strict overrides remain repository-wide all-component proof for backward compatibility.
Runtime receipt refresh routines remain useful for keeping live proof ready; they are not universal merge gates.
Legacy repository-wide proof preserves manifest required:false components as degraded; an explicitly named new dependency is required regardless of its historical optional flag.
